title: Villa of Cicero (Pompeii)
description: The so-called Villa of Cicero is a suburban villa at Pompeii located outside the Porta Ercolano. Discovered during the Bourbon excavations conducted under Francesco La Vega (1748/49, 1763), the site was subsequently reinterred. Beginning in 2026, the site has been investigated again, now employing geophysical methods.
